description: An open-source Android app to let you browse YouTube and other services freely.

latest_release.name: v5.5.0
latest_release.body:
### New Features

- Added multi-select functionality to list pages
- Added a screen lock button during fullscreen playback
- Optimized pinch-to-zoom logic and enabled it by default
- Added support for changing the previous/next track control buttons to fast-forward/rewind
- Added support for YouTube-style live chat, toggleable with danmaku
- Added support for more sorting options
- Added an option to configure whether to show the playback UI on list pages
- Regular expressions (Regex) are now supported for all keyword filters
- Added support for comment filtering by keywords, usernames, or like counts
- Added support for selecting preferred audio quality
- Added DeArrow support

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where playback failed to start under certain circumstances (YouTube)
- Fixed an issue where playback unexpectedly stopped under certain circumstances (YouTube)
- Fixed an issue where search results were fewer than expected under certain circumstances (YouTube)
- Fixed an issue where some tracks could not be played (SoundCloud)
- Fixed an issue where video details did not refresh when returning to the foreground from background playback
- Fixed UI layout errors under certain circumstances
- Fixed crashes that occurred under certain circumstances
- Fixed an issue where importing a playlist via URL failed after leaving the page
- Fixed an issue where SponsorBlock was incorrectly disabled globally under certain circumstances
- Fixed an issue where WebView failed to load under certain circumstances

### Others

- Optimized the UI display for content filtering
- Optimized the in-list search function and unified the icon to a funnel
- Channels can now be blocked by channel ID
- SponsorBlock now supports manually entering start/end times
- Added support for the "Releases" tab on YouTube
- Name sorting can now be switched based on preference (EN/C/J/K)


<hr/>
If you're enjoying PipePipe, please help share it with your friends. Every bit of support means a lot to us!
<hr/>

### Which APK should you download?

- arm64-v8a should work on most devices.
- armeabi-v7a if your device is a 15+ year old phone.
- x86_64 for 64-bit Android simulators (on a PC).
- x86 for 32-bit simulators.

PipePipe

NewPipe, reimagined: faster, more stable, and packed with more features.

## Beyond NewPipe #### YouTube Enhancements * Integrate SponsorBlock for skipping sponsored segments (YouTube & BiliBili) * Restore YouTube dislikes with ReturnYouTubeDislike * Show original titles on YouTube (non-localized) * Log in to access restricted or premium content #### Media Features * Display live chats in danmaku-style overlays * Support AV1 and VP9 codecs for efficient, high-quality playback * Enable music player mode with background playback #### Filtering * Apply advanced search filters for better discovery * Filter out unwanted items by keywords or channels * Block shorts and paid videos for a cleaner feed #### Playback Controls * Use swipe-to-seek and fullscreen gestures for intuitive navigation * Long-press to speed up playback * Set a sleep timer for bedtime listening #### Enhanced Playlists * Download full playlists at once * Search and sort within local playlists and histories #### Plugins * Add new services through plugins (available from 5.6.0) * Browse community plugins in [awesome-pipepipe-plugins](https://github.com/InfinityLoop1308/awesome-pipepipe-plugins) ... and many more improvements! ## Screenshots [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/00-v1.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/01-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/02-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/03-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/04-v3.png)

PipePipe

NewPipe, reimagined: faster, more stable, and packed with more features.

## Beyond NewPipe #### YouTube Enhancements * Integrate SponsorBlock for skipping sponsored segments (YouTube & BiliBili) * Restore YouTube dislikes with ReturnYouTubeDislike * Show original titles on YouTube (non-localized) * Log in to access restricted or premium content #### Media Features * Display live chats in danmaku-style overlays * Support AV1 and VP9 codecs for efficient, high-quality playback * Enable music player mode with background playback #### Filtering * Apply advanced search filters for better discovery * Filter out unwanted items by keywords or channels * Block shorts and paid videos for a cleaner feed #### Playback Controls * Use swipe-to-seek and fullscreen gestures for intuitive navigation * Long-press to speed up playback * Set a sleep timer for bedtime listening #### Enhanced Playlists * Download full playlists at once * Search and sort within local playlists and histories #### Plugins * Add new services through plugins (available from 5.6.0) * Browse community plugins in [awesome-pipepipe-plugins](https://github.com/InfinityLoop1308/awesome-pipepipe-plugins) ... and many more improvements! ## Screenshots [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/00-v1.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/01-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/02-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/03-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/04-v3.png)
[](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/05-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/06-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/07-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/08-v3.png)
[](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/09-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/10-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/11-v3.png) [](fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/12-v3.png) ## About this fork Due to differences in development philosophy, I forked NewPipe in early 2022 and began independent development based on it. This means that PipePipe neither receives updates from NewPipe nor pushes updates to NewPipe. They have become two separate projects. Issues that occur in NewPipe don't necessarily happen in PipePipe, and changes made in NewPipe may not be adopted by PipePipe. In contrast, forks like Tubular track the latest version of NewPipe and develop based on it. Making a hard fork allows us to effectively address issues with quick fixes and maintain frequent feature updates. ## About sign in PipePipe will ONLY use the login cookie for the specified scenarios you set. You can configure it in "Cookie Functions." For YouTube, the cookie will only be used when retrieving playback streams. ## Contribute Issues and PRs are welcomed. Want support for a new service? Write a plugin (available from 5.6.0). Start from the [plugin template](https://github.com/InfinityLoop1308/PipePipePluginTemplate), then submit it to [awesome-pipepipe-plugins](https://github.com/InfinityLoop1308/awesome-pipepipe-plugins) so users can install it from the app. ## Donation If you find PipePipe useful, please consider becoming a supporter on Ko-Fi. Your support is important to me and helps me add more exciting new features. Every bit counts! 😇 Liberapay: https://liberapay.com/PipePipe Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/pipepipe ## Community [PipePipe Wiki](https://priveetee.github.io/Docs-PipePipe) maintained by [@Priveetee](https://github.com/Priveetee) ## Special Thanks [Priveetee](https://github.com/Priveetee) for [researching SABR](https://priveetee.github.io/Docs-PipePipe/developer-guide/introduction.html) and implementing support for it. [AioiLight](https://github.com/AioiLight) for providing some code of NicoNico service.
